ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 82% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized at the peripheral edges and interior splotches creating a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface consists of a central contiguous white field. Black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous band along the trailing edge. Distinct black splotches are located on the interior left lobe (mid-section) and a series of elongated black 'drip' patterns on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated vertex angle of 65 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 2-10 pixels; extreme jaggedness and discontinuous boundaries at the distal tips due to protruding external masses.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, exhibiting an asymmetrical upward curve on the right lobe relative to the camera plane.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured white-and-tan circular clusters (barnacle colonies) heavily localized on the outer 10% of the lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, low-contrast grey linear pixel disruptions oriented horizontally and diagonally across the lower-medial white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization on distal tips; potential rake marks visible as faint parallel grey lines on the left lobe's white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical black streak pattern on the interior right lobe and a cluster of four distinct circular black spots on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe.
